reviewed_invariants: Required rows arise from the finite role recipe, provided rows from checked IR shape/types/effective policies, neither from a submitted responsibility array; shared row constructors do not erase duplicates.
Seven/nine roles and exact finite types/policies are required; one subscription/SourceLease dispatch plus stop/drain/release and non-IR checked-helper identity gate.
Native owner binds exact SDK source inventory, protocol/package identity and SDK metadata reference; reader owner uses locked component source digest, not a fabricated runtime executable hash.
Existing composition wrapper preserves error code/subject/message and empty-required then required-duplicate then provided-duplicate then mismatch order.
Expected MD is created after core checks inside Generate binding, pinned by FileRef before host captures and checks actual bytes. No MD parser is used as a new public wire.

Candidate retention is anchored to immutable backend source facts. Invalid or unrelated backend formats do not inherit the finite recipe; fixed generated Source cannot switch backend facts without changing its source digest.
Legacy Source with no table is not retroactively certified or newly required to have one; nonfixed reader/source is not granted this SDK guarantee.
